messages.subject: Creating custom tabset in index.html
parts:
I'm creating a custom index.html and I have gotten bootstrap working with the tabset.  When I click on a link, it changes the active member, but not the shiny input binding.

Here is the code:

<ul class="nav nav-list shiny-tab-input" id="sidebarNav" role="tablist">
  <li class="active"><a href="#tab-1" data-toggle="tab">Dashboard</a></li>
  <li><a href="#tab-2" data-toggle="tab">Panel 2</a></li>
</ul>

When I first run shiny it says input$sidebarNav is "Dashboard", but it never updates when active changes.  If I change the html so Panel 2 is active on startup, it will say input$sidebarNav is equal to "Panel 2".  Looking through shiny.js, it looks like it should work without custom javascript.  And there is no javascript errors in the console.  I am using bootstrap 3, if that makes a difference with tabsets.

Do I have to add a custom binding, or is there an error?

messages.author: 40878654752107e5
messages.subject: Re: Creating custom tabset in index.html
parts: To answer my own question, the reason for this is that I am using bootstrap 3.  In shiny.js, subscribe is based on `$(el).on('shown.bootstrapTabInputBinding', function(event) {}`.   Now with bootstrap 3, it should be `$(el).on('shown.bs.tab', function(event) {}`
